name: You are given the following quantum programming task. Perform single-qubit state
task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Perform single-qubit state tomography in Qiskit by hand: prepare RY(1.396) RZ(5.476)|0>, measure X, Y, Z expectation values with StatevectorEstimator, reconstruct the density matrix rho = (I + <X>X + <Y>Y + <Z>Z)/2, and report fidelity with the true state. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
